a.lesson: API enabled-configuration storage-limit and dataset-root settings; m0 enabled-configuration check
a.evidence: EM2 enroll layer adds both settings; m0 ENABLED_CONFIG group and m1 recheck before effects
a.residual: Model-based proof; a real API start with these values is unproven until an epoch runs

b.lesson: T1 receipt parsing lost host-listed effects
b.evidence: Parser accepts null blocker detail; unparsed receipts record effects null instead of an empty list; retained EM-1 raw receipts parse with 12 and 2 effects under the EM2 parser
b.residual: See finding F1 for abnormal host output shapes

c.evidence: stopApi treats inactive or failed with no main process, job or cgroup members as stopped and never runs reset-failed
c.residual: Worker stop path still throws on failed (LOW); starting a failed unit without reset-failed could hit the start limit (LOW)

d.lesson: Leftover PB file (PB_EXISTS) and reused names
d.evidence: New v2 PB, layer, namespace and job names; m0 and m1 refuse PB_EXISTS; exclusive no-follow create
d.residual: Remote absence of the v2 names is unproven; gate G5 collision and nonconsumption proof remains open

findings.detail: Abnormal host outputs (SIGTERM or output-cap reports that add a signal key, output-leak guard output) parse locally as SCHEMA, so the local receipt shows effects null while the host-listed effects survive only in the retained raw file. Pass stays false and the lock stays held.
findings.rootDecision: No core change now: a fix would change the pinned core hash and require re-acceptance of the core, chain and controller evidence. Recorded as a known limitation; operators read effects from the retained raw file. Revisit before release.

findings.rootConfirmed: yes: the allowlist scope reader requires namespace .qa-local/codex-r7b-measure-v2 and codeSha equality; that directory currently holds v3 bytes (concatenated 89cdc7c9...), not the EM2 candidate (6e240b31...)
findings.detail: Before any release the nine EM2 files must be installed byte for byte at the declared namespace (or the namespace renamed under review), helper evidence re-run and the release bound to the EM2 core hash.
findings.rootDecision: Added as a release step under readiness gates G5/G6; no change now.
